title: Blitzortung Strike Strike Distance Leaderboard
dataSources: Seismograph (`seismo:reading`), Geiger counter (`geiger:cpm`), lightning strikes (`lightning:strike`), radon (`radon:reading`), all-sky meteor camera (`allsky:capture`), river-level gauge (`riverlevel:reading`), magnetometer (`magnetometer:reading`), satellite passes (`satpass:prediction`).
app: DIY citizen-science sensors — Raspberry Shake seismograph, Geiger counter, AS3935/Blitzortung lightning detector, radon monitor, all-sky meteor camera, river-level gauge, and magnetometer — via MQTT and scripted inputs to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=blitzortung:strike distance_km=*
| stats sum(distance_km) as total_value, avg(distance_km) as avg_value by station_id
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks station values by total and average strike distance across Blitzortung strike events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `distance_km` values for each Blitzortung strike event and review total and average strike distance by station.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total strike distance.
grandmaExplanation: It times which station shows the biggest strike distance numbers in your Blitzortung strike data.
